tests.name: outline interpolation
tests.evidence: All 218 glyphs drawn with BoundsPen at 9 weights × 11 optical sizes; no exceptions/nonfinite bounds/unexpected empty glyphs.

tests.name: encoded line-metric containment
tests.evidence: Zero encoded outlines exceed hhea/Typo ascent2109 descent-614. 372 exceedances belong exclusively to unencoded fractional construction components scaled by parent composites, so they are not encoded clipping defects. MVAR only changes stro/xhgt; line metrics invariant.

tests.name: tabular numerals
tests.evidence: All ten tnum advances equal at every location with kern disabled; pnum produces varied widths. At default tabular advance1286.

tests.name: FreeType grayscale rasterization
tests.evidence: 189 codepoints × weights100/400/700/900 × pixel sizes9/11/14/18/32/72/128 with matching opsz: zero load errors or unexpectedly empty rasters.

tests.name: shaping probes
tests.evidence: 9 strings with default versus kern/liga/calt disabled. Latin and Cyrillic kerning, five f ligatures and canonical Russian decomposition work. Out-of-scope e+acute, é, ï yield .notdef as expected for scope.

tests.name: tnum/calt interaction
tests.evidence: 16 locations × tnum off/on. All 16 tnum-on cases lose colon.case.

tests.name: WOFF2 decoded table equivalence
tests.evidence: All 18 compared tables byte-identical after WOFF2 decoding; head/loca excluded for checksum/storage representation and GlyphOrder is pseudo-table.

ui.reason: All encoded glyphs rasterize at tested UI sizes, but tnum breaks contextual timer-colon alignment. Restrict text to scoped coverage and visually verify target platform.

headings.reason: Engineering pass within 189-codepoint scope: extremes and interior axes draw, Latin/Cyrillic kerning and ligatures function, no encoded line-metric overrun. Does not certify visual taste.

body.reason: In-scope shaping and rasterization work, including decomposed Russian Ё/Й normalization. Accented Latin and general combining marks are outside coverage; platform/readability validation remains.

sustained_reading.reason: No timed reader study or long-form visual evaluation was performed; successful rendering cannot establish fatigue or reading speed.

findings.title: tnum disables contextual timer-colon elevation
findings.evidence: At wght400/opsz14, 12:34 shapes to colon.case with default features, but colon with tnum=1. Colon bounds y=-10..1024 versus colon.case y=205..1239: 215-unit drop (1.47px at 14px). Reproduced at all 16 tested weight/opsz combinations. GSUB tnum lookup precedes calt and context does not match tabular alternates.
findings.concrete_recommendation: Include all digit .tnum glyphs in numeric calt backtrack/lookahead coverage, or otherwise ensure both numeral modes choose colon.case between digits.
findings.acceptance_test: Shape 12:34, 00:00, 99:59 with tnum on/off at weights100/400/700/900 and opsz9/14/28/128; both modes must choose colon.case while lowercase a:b retains colon; tabular digits must remain equal width.

limitations: Independent engineering inspection; no prior reports or other reviewers read before this report. No font/source modifications.
Finite axis grid does not prove absence of every contour crossing or intermediate visual defect.
FreeType rendering success is not a visual quality score; no CoreText, DirectWrite, Safari/Chrome installation, OTS sanitizer, or sustained-reading experiment performed.
Coverage intentionally limited to 189 codepoints. General accented Latin, combining marks, italic/oblique and broader multilingual support not promised or verified.
No actual human, Apple employee or Apple affiliation claimed.
Full static instancing sweep was abandoned as too expensive; direct variable glyph-set evaluation used instead. hhea/Typo containment is valid because MVAR has only stro/xhgt.
